description: Source-quality and evidence-level vocabulary for the canonical enrichment pipeline. Extends schemas/source-class-governance.json with the internal-canonical class used for values derived from already-cited canonical data.

internal-canonical.label: Derived from already-cited canonical workbook data

preclinical-mechanistic.label: In vitro or animal mechanistic study

regulatory-monograph.label: Regulatory agency monograph, guidance, or reference-database authority

systematic-review.label: Systematic review or meta-analysis of human studies

internal-canonical.note: Used only for classification fields whose value is re-derived from other canonical workbook columns that already carry their own provenance. Never acceptable for a claim-bearing field.

overwrite_policies.never: The field is never written by the pipeline.
overwrite_policies.only-if-empty: Write only when the canonical cell is empty or missing-like. A populated cell is a no-op unless the value is equivalent.
overwrite_policies.only-if-higher-confidence: Write when the canonical cell is empty, or when the candidate carries a strictly higher evidence rank AND high confidence. Any replacement of a non-equivalent populated value routes to review.
overwrite_policies.manual-review: Never written automatically. Candidates are exported for a human to accept.
